description: This file defines the 'BuzzShare' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing shared posts or shares within the Buzz feature. It includes properties such as post details, employee info, likes, comments, timestamps, and post types. The class is annotated for ORM mapping to the 'ohrm_buzz_share' table.

classes.name: BuzzShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a share or post in the Buzz feature, with properties for post, employee, likes, comments, type, text, and timestamps, along with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost object with this share.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who created the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of share (post or share).

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the share.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the share.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the UTC creation timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Retrieves the UTC timestamp of last update.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the UTC timestamp of last update to current UTC time.
